scripts.build: node -e "fs.rmSync('./dist', {recursive:true, force:true})" && tsc && vite build --mode preprod && node -e "fs.cpSync('../contract/src/managed/bboard/keys', './dist/keys', {recursive:true})" && node -e "fs.cpSync('../contract/src/managed/bboard/zkir', './dist/zkir', {recursive:true})"
scripts.build:preview: node -e "fs.rmSync('./dist', {recursive:true, force:true})" && tsc && vite build --mode preview && node -e "fs.cpSync('../contract/src/managed/bboard/keys', './dist/keys', {recursive:true})" && node -e "fs.cpSync('../contract/src/managed/bboard/zkir', './dist/zkir', {recursive:true})"
scripts.build:start: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.build:start:preview: npm run build:preview && npm run start
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
